title: Fix missing Class 8/9 students across screens and add monthly attendance export to Excel (CSV)

requirements.text: Fix the backend student lookup so that selecting Class 8 or Class 9 (any section) returns the already-existing students (same behavior as Class 7) instead of appearing empty and prompting users to add students.

quotes: 8 और 9 के छात्र अभी भी नहीं आ रहे हैं जैसे ही क्लास और section select karte Hain to add Student ke liye kehta Hai
2 student kahi nahi dikh rahe hai

acceptanceCriteria: Given existing student records with className='8' or className='9', calling getClassSectionStudents('8','A') / getClassSectionStudents('9','A') returns those students instead of an empty list.
StudentListPage and AttendancePage show students for Class 8/9 after selecting class/section, without requiring re-adding students.
Fix does not break student retrieval for other classes/sections.

requirements.text: Make student storage resilient to canister upgrades so previously added students do not disappear after redeploy/upgrade; ensure any needed indexes/counters are restored correctly on upgrade.

quotes: 8 और 9 के छात्र अभी भी नहीं आ रहे हैं
student kahi nahi dikh rahe hai

acceptanceCriteria: After a canister upgrade, previously added students remain retrievable via getAllStudents and getClassSectionStudents.
Any class/section indexing used for getClassSectionStudents continues to work correctly after upgrade without manual intervention.
The student ID counter continues from the prior maximum so newly added students do not overwrite or collide with existing IDs.

requirements.text: Implement backend roll-call persistence APIs so attendance is stored in the canister (not only in browser localStorage), and can be queried for a given day and for a given month/class/section.

quotes: student monthly data Excel main download ho

acceptanceCriteria: A new backend method exists to save a daily roll call for a (date, className, section) and a method exists to fetch it back reliably.
A backend query exists to list roll calls for a month for a (className, section), returning enough data to generate a monthly export.
Saving attendance from the UI persists to the backend and remains available after page refresh (and after canister upgrade per REQ-2).

requirements.text: Add a Monthly Export feature that lets the user download monthly student attendance data as an Excel-compatible CSV file (English headers), with month selection and class/section taken from the current session.

quotes: student monthly data Excel main download ho

acceptanceCriteria: From the app UI, the user can choose a month (and year if needed) and download a .csv file that opens correctly in Excel.

The exported CSV contains one row per student (or a clearly documented alternative, e.g., one row per student per day), and includes class, section, student name, roll number, and attendance values for the month.
If the user is not logged in/authorized, the export shows a clear English error message instead of downloading an empty or corrupt file.

requirements.text: Update the roll-call frontend hooks to use the new backend roll-call APIs (instead of the temporary localStorage implementation) so attendance data and monthly export are consistent across devices/browsers.

quotes: student monthly data Excel main download ho

acceptanceCriteria: Marking attendance and viewing the Summary uses backend-stored data for the selected day.
Refreshing the browser does not lose saved attendance for that day/month.
Monthly export uses the same backend source of truth as the Attendance/Summary screens.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (single-actor architecture).

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and anything under frontend/src/components/ui.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: PDF export (only Excel-compatible CSV is required for this request).
Third-party auth providers other than Internet Identity.
